resources.string: Navigate selected apps with physical keys

Use physical keys in BankID and Wise PIN screens, and standard navigation in the apps you enable in Key Navigator. D-pad arrows move a highlight between visible controls and centre activates the highlighted control. D-pad Up and Down automatically scroll near list edges. Keys 2 and 5 move up and down without scrolling. BankID uses specialised reading and PIN controls. Wise has specialised PIN controls. No PIN or field contents are stored or logged.

Enable physical-key controls for chosen apps.
D-pad arrows: move the blue highlight
D-pad centre: activate the highlighted control
2: move up without scrolling
5: move down without scrolling
Back and typing work normally. When any text field has input focus, 2 and 5 pass through for normal typing and T9

Wise and BankID have enabled PIN entry using physical keys regardless of their toggle. Get in touch at support@dumbermini.com to request physical PIN input support in your app or to report an issue.
